jobs.title: Agricultural Operations Assistant (Trainee)
jobs.exactAddress: National Highway, Brgy. Tagaran, Cauayan City, Isabela
jobs.landmark: Across Isabela State University - Cauayan Extension, 5 mins from City Hall
jobs.commuteTip: Just one tricycle ride from Marabulig 1 or a northbound jeepney heading toward Tagaran.
jobs.description: Assist the agronomy and field operations team with crop cycle tracking, warehouse inventory of agricultural supplies, and coordination with local farming cooperatives in Isabela.
jobs.qualifications: Fresh graduates of BS Agriculture, Agribusiness, Agricultural Engineering, or related courses. Willing to conduct field visits in Cauayan City & Luna barangays.
screeningQuestions: Are you comfortable conducting morning field visits within Cauayan City barangays?
Briefly share your agricultural coursework, OJT, or cooperative experience.

jobs.title: Junior IT Helpdesk & Support Specialist
jobs.exactAddress: Maharlika Highway, Brgy. San Fermin, Cauayan City, Isabela
jobs.landmark: 2nd Floor, IT Commercial Building (Across SM City Cauayan)
jobs.commuteTip: Very close to Marabulig 1; only 5 to 7 minutes via tricycle or regular jeepney along Maharlika Highway.
jobs.description: Provide level-1 technical support for business workstations, LAN/WiFi configuration, peripheral installation, and basic cloud account administration for local enterprises.
jobs.qualifications: BS Information Technology, Computer Science, or Computer Engineering graduate. Strong troubleshooting logic and customer-oriented service mindset.
screeningQuestions: Can you commute to Brgy. San Fermin (near SM City Cauayan) for onsite days?
List any hardware, networking, or helpdesk ticketing tools you have used.

jobs.title: Front Office Guest Service Associate
jobs.exactAddress: Rizal Avenue, District 1 (Poblacion), Cauayan City, Isabela
jobs.landmark: Near Cauayan Public Market and St. Anthony Parish Church
jobs.commuteTip: Drop off at Centro / Plaza; 24-hour tricycle terminal available near the entrance.
jobs.description: Welcomes corporate and leisure guests, handles reservations and room check-ins/check-outs, manages billing inquiries, and delivers warm hospitality typical of Cagayan Valley.
jobs.qualifications: BS Hospitality Management, Tourism, or any 4-year degree. Good English communication skills; conversational Ilocano or Tagalog is an advantage.
screeningQuestions: Are you available for shifting schedules including weekends and holidays?
Which languages or dialects can you speak comfortably with guests?

jobs.title: Operations & QA Line Trainee
jobs.exactAddress: Industrial Zone, Brgy. Victoria, Alicia, Isabela
jobs.landmark: Corner of Alicia-San Mateo Provincial Road
jobs.commuteTip: Moderate distance from Cauayan Centro; take an Alicia or Santiago jeepney from Cauayan Central Terminal (~30 mins travel).
jobs.description: Hands-on training in automated packaging machinery, quality control testing against Philippine Bureau of Product Standards, and safety compliance recording.
jobs.qualifications: Industrial Technology, Mechanical Tech, BS Industrial Engineering, or fresh vocational / TESDA NC II/NC III holders.
screeningQuestions: Do you hold any TESDA NC II / NC III certifications or mechanical training?
Confirm you can travel to Industrial Zone, Alicia, Isabela for 8 AM shifts.

jobs.title: Junior Records & Administrative Clerk
jobs.exactAddress: Purok 2, Brgy. Marabulig 1, Cauayan City, Isabela
jobs.landmark: Across Marabulig 1 Barangay Hall & Elementary School
jobs.commuteTip: Located right inside Barangay Marabulig 1! Very walkable or a short ₱15 tricycle ride.
jobs.description: Maintain electronic records, handle correspondence with Cauayan City Hall and business partners, generate billing reports, and coordinate internal office appointments.
jobs.qualifications: BS Business Administration, Office Administration, Public Administration, or related degree. Proficient in MS Excel / Google Sheets and document drafting.
screeningQuestions: Rate your proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets and document filing.
Are you eligible under the First-Time Jobseekers Act (RA 11261)?

jobs.title: Customer Experience Representative (Voice / Chat)
jobs.exactAddress: 3rd Floor, Cauayan Cyber Hub, Brgy. Cabaruan, Cauayan City, Isabela
jobs.landmark: Adjacent to Cauayan City Airport Road & City Convention Center
jobs.commuteTip: Free company shuttle service provided nightly from SM City Cauayan for call center shifts.
jobs.description: Handle customer inquiries for telecommunication and e-commerce clients. Paid 4-week training provided with full healthcare and allowances upon day one.
jobs.qualifications: College graduate or at least 2 years in college completed. Fresh graduates with confident conversational English skills are heavily encouraged to apply.
screeningQuestions: Are you open to graveyard/night shifts with complimentary shuttle pickup at SM Cauayan?
Share a brief example of how you handle stressful customer conversations.

jobs.title: Social Media & Community Marketing Assistant
jobs.landmark: Adjacent to Naguilian Municipal Hall & Rizal Park
jobs.commuteTip: Hybrid setup: 2 days in office in Naguilian, 3 days work-from-home. One ride via Ilagan bus or jeepney.
jobs.description: Create engaging social media content, assist in organizing local job caravans and product expos across Isabela, and monitor digital campaign engagement metrics.
jobs.qualifications: BS Marketing, Communications, Advertising, or Multimedia Arts. Familiar with Canva, basic video editing, and social media analytics.
screeningQuestions: Share a link or brief description of a Canva/social post or campaign you created.
Can you report onsite to Naguilian Poblacion twice a week?

jobs.title: Junior Data Entry & E-Commerce Coordinator
jobs.exactAddress: Work from Home (Cauayan City & Isabela Applicants)
jobs.landmark: Monthly team meetup near SM City Cauayan
jobs.commuteTip: Zero daily commute required; stable fiber internet (15+ Mbps) recommended.
jobs.description: Process online catalog updates, verify merchant orders, reconcile daily spreadsheet inventories, and respond to partner emails remotely from home.
jobs.qualifications: Any college degree or senior high school graduate with strong attention to detail, laptop/PC access, and reliable home internet.
screeningQuestions: Do you have access to a personal computer/laptop and reliable internet connection?
What is your typing speed and familiarity with spreadsheet formulas?
